summary: End-to-end frontend test of Phase 3 Supabase integration (auth + onboarding + real CRUD for Customers/Leads/Parts + cross-org RLS). 11 of 12 scenarios PASSED. The critical RLS isolation test passed: user2 saw empty tables (0/0/0) across all three modules while user1's data persisted (1/1/1) after re-login. One minor issue found: when creating a Part immediately after navigating to the module, the native <select> for customer_id contained only the 'Select…' placeholder — the async fetchCustomerOptions() had not resolved by the time the drawer was opened, resulting in the part being saved with customer_id=null (row displays '—' instead of 'ABC Auto Components').

ui_bugs.issue: Race condition: customer_id <select> renders empty (only 'Select…' option) when drawer is opened before fetchCustomerOptions() resolves. Newly created parts get customer_id=null and row shows '—' for Customer column even when customers exist. Repro: nav-parts → immediately click create-part-button → open dropdown → only 'Select…' present.

issues: Green dot exists visually next to Customers, Leads & Follow-ups and Part Master items (verified in screenshot), but is not implemented with a bg-green/bg-emerald Tailwind class, so it is not queryable via those class selectors. Consider adding a data-testid like 'nav-live-indicator-<module>' for testability.

action_items: Fix Parts create-drawer race: either (a) await loadCustomerOptions() before enabling create-part-button, (b) show a loading state on the customer select until options are ready, or (c) call loadCustomerOptions() again on drawer open. Currently a user who clicks 'New part' fast enough will silently save a part with no linked customer.
Optional: add data-testid to sidebar live-connection dots for easier automated verification.
critical_code_review_comments: PartsModule.jsx line 32-33: fetchCustomerOptions error is swallowed silently ('/* ignore */'). If the query fails (RLS/network), the user has no feedback and the dropdown is silently empty. Show toast.error(e.message) like the load() function does.

PartsModule.jsx: customerOptions is loaded once on mount but not refreshed when a customer is added in the Customers module. If the user creates a customer in another tab / earlier session and then opens Parts, that customer will show, but within a single session flow the timing is fragile — consider re-fetching on drawer open.
test_credentials: Created dynamically per run: e2e-<timestamp>-1@qatest.local and e2e-<timestamp>-2@qatest.local, password Passw0rd! (email confirmation disabled at Supabase project level — signup returns immediate session).
seed_data_creation: Each run creates 2 Supabase auth users, 2 organizations ('QA Company One', 'QA Company Two'), 1 customer (ABC Auto Components), 1 lead (XYZ Motors), 1 part (HSG-284) under org1. Consider adding a cleanup job or a scheduled purge of e2e-* users in Supabase.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full Phase 3 smoke passed. All testids match implementation. Signup → immediate session → onboarding-form works. Cross-org RLS verified end-to-end on real Supabase (user2 sees 0 rows in customers/leads/parts). Company selector is per-user correctly. The only functional gap is the Parts customer dropdown race described above. When writing Playwright, note: (1) customer-field-status, lead-field-source, lead-field-status, part-field-unit are native <select>s use select_option; (2) toasts are Sonner bottom-right; (3) search has ~500ms debounce; (4) 'PRECISE INDUSTRIES' brand text is split across two lines in the sidebar so text= exact-match won't work, use partial.
rca of the issue: Parts customer dropdown empty: In PartsModule.jsx the drawer's FIELDS array is built from `customerOptions` state, which starts as []. loadCustomerOptions() is fired in useEffect on mount but is async — if the user clicks 'New part' before the fetch resolves, the DrawerForm renders with only the empty placeholder option. Saving proceeds without validation, persisting customer_id=null. Fix: either gate the create button on `customerOptions.length > 0 || loading===false`, or trigger a fresh loadCustomerOptions() when the drawer opens and show a spinner inside the select until it resolves.
